title: Gibson Dual Falcon 20 2x10 Combo, EU, Surf Bronco, Exclusive

long_description.title: Gibson Dual Falcon 20 in Exclusive Surf Bronco
long_description.body:
Featuring an exclusive Surf Bronco vinyl with a Bone grille cloth, the Gibson Dual Falcon 20 2x10 Combo Amplifier sports groovy aesthetics and boutique-level build quality. The Gibson Dual Falcon 20’s sound, simplicity, and cabinet were all inspired by the cult-classic Gibson Falcon amps from the early 1960s. However, while it might look like a vintage piece of gear, the Falcon is a fresh design from the founder of MESA/Boogie®, Randall Smith, in partnership with the MESA/Boogie Design Team. Gibson Amplifiers are handcrafted in Petaluma, California, and set the bar for low-wattage tone with modern features for today’s players.

This exclusive Dual Falcon 20 wrapped in Surf Bronco vinyl adds a splash of color to the vintage aesthetic of the Gibson Dual Falcon 20, with the contrast of the Bone grille cloth helping it stand out from the crowd. The mixture of vintage aesthetics with this exciting new colorway makes for an amplifier that looks and sounds great both on stage and in the studio.

Powered by a matched pair of 6L6 power amp tubes, the Dual Falcon 20 produces 15 watts of pure tube tone. But if you don’t want to overwhelm the rest of the band or need to dial things back for home recording or rehearsals, the Dual Falcon 20’s Multi-Watt™ Power and Duo-Class™ wiring allows players to select between Full, Half, or Low (15, 6, or 2-watts) power modes separately for each of the two channels. Using optional 6V6 power tubes delivers 12, 5, and 1-watt across the three power modes. All this power is sent to a pair of 10” Jenson® Blackbird speakers, which deliver a very different flavor in comparison to the 1x12 Gibson Falcon 20. While they are not as common in guitar amplifiers as 12” speakers, 10” speakers have a significant following and have been used in numerous legendary models over the years.

Other key features of the Dual Falcon 20 include onboard tube-driven spring reverb and all-tube tremolo for authentic vintage-style effects. A useful additional feature is the ¼” Monitor Out, which captures the entire sound of the amplifier from the preamp and power amp sections and provides a padded send. This has myriad uses, from feeding a parallel signal to a console or external processor in recording scenarios to using in conjunction with additional power amplifiers to drive extra cabinets for larger stage applications.

With the exclusive Surf Bronco vinyl covering paired with a Bone grille cloth, this exclusive Dual Falcon 20 combo is a great fit for any vintage tone enthusiast who wants the additional convenience of a touch of modern technology. The Dual Falcon 20 is packed with features but thanks to its simple control panel, it’s easy to get a great tone with just a few simple tweaks. Included with the amplifier is a slipcover to protect the beautiful Surf Bronco vinyl wrap and keep dust off the control panel.

Handcrafted in Petaluma, California

All-Tube Amplifier: 2x 6L6 Power Tubes (optional 2x 6V6) / 4x 12AX7 Preamp Tubes

Pure Class A Power

Patented Multi-Watt Power, featuring Duo-Class wiring, providing per channel power choices of FULL power (approx. 15 Watts) - 2x 6L6 Push-Pull, Class A, Pentode; HALF power (approx. 6 Watts) - 2x 6L6 Push-Pull, Class A, Triode; or LOW power (approx. 2 Watts) - 1x 6L6 Single-Ended, Class A, Pentode (approx. 12 Watts, 5 Watts, and 1 Watt with optional 6V6 Power Tubes)

Cathode Biased, Maintenance-Free

Normal or Low (Cleaner) Inputs

Dual Channel Flexibility – Channel Features: Independent Volume, Tone, and Reverb Controls

Global Tremolo with Depth and Frequency (Speed) Controls

Spring Reverb & Tremolo are Tube-Driven and Footswitchable

Buffered, Series Effects Loop

Monitor (Slave) DI Output – Fixed Attenuated from the Speaker Output

Polished Stainless Steel Control Faceplate

Aluminum Chassis

3 Button Footswitch Included (Channel 1/2, Reverb & Tremolo)

Slipcover Included

Two 10” Jensen Blackbird 40 Alnico Speakers
